text: 你们碰巧找到一处够深的洞穴，能避开地表的浓烟和热浪。大火把你们困在地下一天多。
终于走出洞穴时，你看见满目焦黑的荒地。想到山谷独特的动植物可能遭到的破坏，你感到一阵恶心。你们越过仍在阴燃的灰烬与焦土，穿过无尽的苍白尖桩和烧黑的树干，来到那处裂隙，从那里离开失落之地。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 404
text: Your party chances upon a cave deep enough to shelter you from the smoke and heat on the surface. For over a day, the fire traps you underground.

When you finally emerge, you see a charred, devastated landscape. The probable damage to the valley’s unique flora and fauna sickens you. Over a carpet of smoldering embers and ash, through endless stands of whitened spikes and blackened logs, you make your way to the fissure by which you now leave the lost land.
